lines.text: Isaiah son of Amoz saw a vision of Judah and Jerusalem, and the LORD said His children had rebelled.
Isaiah says the land is desolate, the cities are burned, and foreigners devour the fields.
Isaiah says the LORD of Hosts left a few survivors, and he calls the rulers rulers of Babylon.
The LORD says their hands are covered with ashes, and He tells them to defend the fatherless and the widow.
The LORD says scarlet sins will become white as snow, and the willing and obedient will eat the best.
